title: Chronos-2: A foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.41956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate forecasting with uncertainty quantification is critical in a variety of scientific applications ranging from epidemiology and economics to energy systems and earth sciences. Yet most forecasting models still need to be developed and trained separately for each domain-specific dataset. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) aim to remove this limitation and enable the application of the same model across domains through large-scale pretraining. However, most existing TSFMs treat each time series independently and therefore cannot model interactions among time series and external drivers. Here, we introduce Chronos-2, a foundation model for zero-shot forecasting that models the interactions between multivariate time series and heterogeneous covariates, which commonly arise in scientific applications. translated_title: Chronos-2：一个用于多变量时间序列预测的基础模型
translated_abstract: 在从流行病学、经济学到能源系统和地球科学等各种科学应用中，带有不确定性量化的准确预测至关重要。然而，大多数预测模型仍需要针对每个特定领域的数据集单独开发和训练。时间序列基础模型（TSFM）旨在消除这一限制，通过大规模预训练使同一模型能够跨领域应用。然而，大多数现有的时间序列基础模型将每条时间序列独立处理，因此无法建模时间序列之间以及时间序列与外部驱动因素之间的相互作用。本文提出了Chronos-2，一个用于零样本预测的基础模型，它能够建模多变量时间序列与异构协变量之间的交互，而这在科学应用中十分常见。该模型直接从历史上下文中推断时间序列之间的关系，并生成概率预测，无需任务……
tldr: Chronos-2是一个零样本多变量时间序列预测基础模型，通过大规模预训练能够建模时间序列之间及其与异构协变量之间的交互，直接从历史数据中推断关系并生成带有不确定性量化的概率预测。
en_tdlr: Chronos-2 is a zero-shot foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting that models interactions among time series and heterogeneous covariates, inferring relationships directly from historical context to produce probabilistic forecasts with uncertainty quantification.
